critical_code_review_comments: ALL DASHBOARD DATA IS MOCKED - metrics, charts, room status, AI performance, ROI, channels, alerts, lost analysis all use generateMockData() functions
Time range selectors are functional but only regenerate mock data with different day counts
Alert dismiss functionality works but alerts are re-generated on page refresh (no persistence)
Good use of data-testid attributes for key elements (login form, tabs)
Dark theme UI is well-implemented with consistent color scheme (#FF6B35 orange, #00B4D8 cyan, #22c55e green)
